# CLAUDE.md

This file provides guidance to Claude Code when working with this repository.

## Project conventions

- Source lives in `src/`.
- Run `npm test` before every commit.

Note: `setup-planning-v3.sh` never touches `CLAUDE.md`, so there is no delimited
Planning Framework section here at all. Converge must add exactly one (T4).

(No delimiter literal appears in this file: T4 counts them with grep and expects
exactly one pair after converge.)
